annotation.title_clean: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.title_en: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ruler of Dubai (Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum); Supreme Legislation Committee in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.summary_en: Dubai Law No. 9 of 2023 regulates autonomous vehicle operation in the Emirate. It makes the Roads and Transport Authority the regulator, requires vehicle licences and activity permits, sets technical and inspection requirements, covers data handling and complaints, and defaults to the federal traffic law where it is silent. It came into force 90 days after publication.
key_provisions_or_claims: No autonomous vehicle may travel on roads without an RTA licence.
No one may conduct an autonomous vehicle activity without an RTA permit.
Vehicles licensed elsewhere in the UAE need a Dubai permit before operating in the Emirate.
The RTA inspects and monitors permit holders, handles complaints, and compiles and classifies operational data.
Federal Traffic Law No. 21 of 1995 applies where this Law is silent, taking account of the nature of autonomous vehicles.
